scope.interpretation_summary: The intelligent prosthetic market encompasses advanced prosthetic devices that integrate technology to enhance functionality and user experience. Participants include manufacturers, distributors, and service providers op
scope.market_definition: The intelligent prosthetic market encompasses advanced prosthetic devices that integrate technology to enhance functionality and user experience. Participants include manufacturers, distributors, and service providers operating globally to deliver innovative solutions for individuals with limb loss.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the production of intelligent prosthetic devices using advanced materials and technologies.
This layer includes the distribution of intelligent prosthetics through various channels to reach end-users.
This layer focuses on the integration of intelligent prosthetics into healthcare systems and the provision of related services.

## TASKA PowerCore

#### Power Refined.

The TASKA PowerCore enables clinicians to craft elegant sockets that deliver reliable power.

[Learn More][87]

## Zeus M

#### Strong. Fast. Built for every fit.

The powerful Zeus hand is now available in both small and medium sizes and all sizes are available
with a standard quick disconnect or flex wrist. Now users have even more control, more comfort, more
possibilities.

## Formula Fit: Bridging the Gap

The Formula Fit is designed for active adolescents and small adults. It delivers flexible power, low
build height, and room to grow, bridging the gap between the Formula Ultra and the Pediatric
Formula, for reliable K3–K4 performance.

1. Evaluation and Plan

The first part of the [POSI Process][131] consists of important questions about your hobbies and
daily activities etc. On top of that, we will give you a physical evaluation to test general muscle
strength and flexibility.

2. Hand Casting

This is the first step in fitting and will involve an impression of the residual limb. The hand cast
will be made using a plaster to create a model to be modified to fit each specific patient.

3. Diagnostic Fittings

During the diagnostic fitting, it allows us to continue to adjust to any changes that might need to
be made throughout the alignment process as well as make it more comfortable overall.

In-House Fabrication simply makes it easier to make adjustments on site while you wait as well as
quick feedback.

# Welcome to Hanger Clinic

Expert Orthotic and Prosthetic Care in Chicago

[ Request an appointment ][52]

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. We create customized solutions for people of all ages,
including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, cranial helmets, and other devices designed to
increase the mobility and function of each person we serve.

[Request an Appointment][53]

Whether you’re visiting a former Scheck & Siress location or another Hanger Clinic location, we
provide dedicated, high-quality care focused on you, our patients. Scheck & Siress provided the
highest level of orthotic and prosthetic care for years before joining Hanger Clinic, and continues
to do so as part of the Hanger Clinic family, with the added benefits of additional resources.

## Find a Clinic Near You

Choose a convenient Chicago area location from the list below, or [search all of our clinics][54].

## Explore Our Expertise

### *****The peace of mind you need. The commitment you deserve.*****

We create customized solutions—including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, supports, cranial
helmets, and other devices—designed to help you live your best life. Our commitment is to listen to
you, get to know you as a person, and do everything we can to help you achieve your potential.

[male patient with above-knee prosthesis sitting on steps]

## Lower Limb Prosthetics

With solutions for all levels of lower limb loss and limb difference, including above-knee
amputation and below-knee amputation, our expert prosthetists will work with you to find the best
prosthetic solution for you.

***Technology Highlights:***
* [Microprocessor Knees][55]
* [Microprocessor Feet][56]
* [Hydraulic Ankle/Feet][57]

[male clinician with male patient with right arm prosthesis]

## Upper Limb Prosthetics

Our upper limb specialists design custom prosthetic solutions for people needing prosthetic arms,
hands, and fingers. Our advanced materials and state-of-the-art components work with you and empower
you to continue to do the things you love.

***Technology Highlight:***
* [*Myoelectric Hooks and Hands*][58]

## Cranial Helmets

Cranial remolding helmets are often prescribed to treat cranial asymmetry, like plagiocephaly, also
known as “flat head syndrome.” We are here to help put your mind at ease by providing you with the
expertise, education, and support you need to feel comfortable and confident about the journey
ahead.

[Learn More >][59]

## Lower Limb Bracing

Our clinicians work with individuals of all ages and offer a full range of treatment options ranging
from sports orthoses for young athletes to specialty orthoses to help treat a variety of
neuromuscular and orthopedic disorders including cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, and down
syndrome.

[Learn More >][60]

## Scoliosis Bracing

A spine doctor may prescribe a scoliosis brace, also known as a Thoracic Lumbar Sacral Orthosis
(TLSO) for your child. The TLSO works by applying pressure over the back in specific areas to
straighten the spine while your child is wearing the brace.

[Learn More >][61]

## Empowering Your Next Step

team works closely with you to understand your needs, goals, and daily movement. Every solution is

[Request a Consultation][39]

## Compassionate Care from Certified Experts

Founded in 2007, Bionic Prosthetics & Orthotics combines board-certified clinicians with
personalized care plans helping thousands regain comfort, mobility, and confidence.
* Certified & state-licensed prosthetists & orthotists
* Custom solutions for children & adults
* Full-service fittings, adjustments & follow-up care
* Functional Electrical Stimulation (FES) options

[Meet Our Team][40]
[Compassionate Care from Certified Experts.webp]

## Services We Offer

Every person’s movement is unique, and prosthetic or orthotic solutions should reflect your body,
condition, and daily life. At Bionic Prosthetics & Orthotics, we begin with a detailed clinical
evaluation to recommend solutions focused on function, comfort, and long-term use.

[Prosthetic Care.webp]

### Prosthetic Care

Our prosthetic services support individuals with upper- and lower-limb loss or limb difference at
every stage of life.

We focus on:
* Restoring balance and natural movement patterns
* Reducing energy loss and fatigue during walking or daily activities
* Supporting work, recreation, and independent living

Each prosthesis is carefully selected and customized based on your anatomy, mobility goals, and
lifestyle, with ongoing adjustments as your needs evolve.

### Orthotic Care

Orthotic care is designed to support the body’s structure, improve alignment, and reduce strain on
muscles and joints.

We provide custom orthotic solutions for:
* Foot and ankle instability
* Knee, hip, and spinal conditions
* Post-injury and post-surgical recovery
* Long-term musculoskeletal conditions

Our goal is to improve comfort, stability, and movement efficiency while helping reduce pain and
prevent further complications.

[Orthotic Care.webp]
[Diabetic Foot Care.webp]

### Diabetic Foot Care

Diabetes can significantly affect foot health, circulation, and sensation, making proper support
essential.

Our diabetic foot care services focus on:
* Reducing pressure on high-risk areas
* Protecting sensitive or vulnerable tissue
* Supporting safe, confident walking

We design specialized footwear and orthotic solutions to help lower the risk of ulcers and other
complications while supporting long-term mobility.

### Pediatric Prosthetics & Orthotics

Children’s prosthetic and orthotic needs change as they grow, develop, and become more active.

Our pediatric care emphasizes:
* Comfort and proper fit during growth
* Supporting healthy movement and development
* Encouraging confidence at home, school, and play

We work closely with families and care teams to ensure each solution adapts over time, supporting
both physical development and independence.

[Pediatric Prosthetics & Orthotics_edited.jpg]

Our board-certified prosthetists and orthotists provide personalized care focused on comfort,
function, and long-term support. With clinics across multiple locations, expert care is always
within reach; use our location finder to connect with a clinician near you.

## ABOUT US

##### Rehab Modalities - PERKESO

Rehab Modalities is a marketing division of PERKESO Rehabilitation Centre. As an aggregator of
modalities, Rehab Modalities first use the application and closely monitor how it improves patient
recovery, and then we recommend the products to the outside world.

Rehab modalities will provide rehab-related modalities, technology, and solutions. Our services
include sales, distribution, and logistics processes behind equipment supply from global leaders
such as Cyberdyne, Techno Concept, Life Sciences Robotics, and Light Force Medical.

##### Our Goal

The goal is to holistically treat patients and prepare them for a successful return to work and
social life. Rehab Modalities, a division of the centre, tests and endorses cutting-edge neuro
rehabilitation technology and provides sales, distribution, and logistics for globally recognised
companies.

##### Our Focus

The clinic focuses on patient-centred care and innovative therapeutic options, combining
physiotherapy and neurorehabilitation to rehabilitation with technologies like Cyberdyne and
Vibramoov for the well-being of patients worldwide.

## Why Choose Rehab Modalities?

[RehabModalities-PERKESO-Neurorehabilitaion]

Over 12,500 patients were treated at the PERKESO Rehabilitation Centre using high-tech
rehabilitation equipment from the Rehab Modalities portfolio. This demonstrates the exceptional
quality and versatility of the equipment. Our cutting-edge neurorobotics technologies and

## ROBERT®

ROBERT® transforms the process of patient recovery by using its innovative method to efficiently and
quickly mobilise individuals. This cutting-edge robot, carefully constructed and developed to
assists patients in their rehabilitation endeavours by enabling a variety of rehabilitation
exercises. ROBERT® marks a significant advancement in modern healthcare by providing exceptional
support.

## LIGHTFORCE®

LightForce® Deep Tissue Laser Therapy range provides various treatment options for both short-term
and long-term conditions, such as alleviating pain, enhancing blood flow, and expediting
post-activity recovery. LightForce® Laser Therapy has advanced power and intelligent functions make
it a great choice for professionals in the rehabilitation field.

[KNOW MORE][20]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

## VIBRAMOOV®

Vibramoov® offers advanced methods for preserving and improving sensory-motor function in people
with motor impairments. It supports motor recovery, encourages neuroplasticity, reduces the negative
effects of immobility, and utilises innovative vibration technology. Embraced by healthcare
professionals, Vibramoov® facilitates successful rehabilitation and enhances coordination,
positioning itself as an essential tool in neurorehabilitation.

## ABOUT US

##### Rehab Modalities - PERKESO

Rehab Modalities is a marketing division of PERKESO Rehabilitation Centre. As an aggregator of
modalities, Rehab Modalities first use the application and closely monitor how it improves patient
recovery, and then we recommend the products to the outside world.

Rehab modalities will provide rehab-related modalities, technology, and solutions. Our services
include sales, distribution, and logistics processes behind equipment supply from global leaders
such as Cyberdyne, Techno Concept, Life Sciences Robotics, and Light Force Medical.

##### Our Goal

The goal is to holistically treat patients and prepare them for a successful return to work and
social life. Rehab Modalities, a division of the centre, tests and endorses cutting-edge neuro
rehabilitation technology and provides sales, distribution, and logistics for globally recognised
companies.

##### Our Focus

The clinic focuses on patient-centred care and innovative therapeutic options, combining
physiotherapy and neurorehabilitation to rehabilitation with technologies like Cyberdyne and
Vibramoov for the well-being of patients worldwide.

serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

### What is a Cochlear Implant and How Does It Work?

A cochlear implant is a small electronic device that helps people with severe hearing loss hear more
clearly.

Unlike hearing aids, which make sounds louder, a hearing implant sends sound waves directly to your
nerves.

It’s designed to help you understand speech more clearly, especially in noisy places, and reconnect
with the sounds that matter most.

FAQ

### Common Questions About Cochlear Hearing Implants

### How is a hearing implant different from a hearing aid?

A cochlear implant (CI), sometimes referred to as a hearing implant, is considered the next step in
hearing technology when hearing aids are no longer providing the sound or support someone needs.
Hearing aids go on the outside of the body and work like a speaker, making sound louder. Cochlear
implants go under the skin and send sound waves directly to your hearing nerve for clearer
understanding. 

[ Learn more about the process for adults ][84]

### Are cochlear implants safe?

Yes. Cochlear implants are extremely safe. They’ve been used for decades and have helped hundreds of
thousands of people around the world hear again and reconnect with life.

## Zeus M

#### Strong. Fast. Built for every fit.

The powerful Zeus hand is now available in both small and medium sizes and all sizes are available
with a standard quick disconnect or flex wrist. Now users have even more control, more comfort, more
possibilities.

## Formula Fit: Bridging the Gap

The Formula Fit is designed for active adolescents and small adults. It delivers flexible power, low
build height, and room to grow, bridging the gap between the Formula Ultra and the Pediatric
Formula, for reliable K3–K4 performance.

# Empowering Human Potential

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. With more than 900 locations across the country, we
create customized solutions for people of all ages, including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces,
cranial helmets, and other devices designed to increase the mobility and function of each person we
serve.
* **1 Million** Patients Treated Annually
* **925** Locations Nationwide
* **1,800** Clinical Providers
* **2,500** In-network Insurance Providers

*Numbers are approximate

## Patient Stories

[Shima Nixon][60] You have to get up, you have to keep moving. Everything that happened on my
journey was worth it because it pushed me out of my comfort zone. Now I get to be part of something
bigger than me. [Read Her Story ›][61]
[Shima Nixon][62]
[Alex Smith][63] Going back to how much I’ve benefited from the progression of medicine and this
rehab, certainly for limb injuries and leg injuries — I do feel like I owe on some level to push
this to see how far it can go for whoever may come after. [Read His Story ›][64]
[Alex Smith][65]
[Billy Parker][66] My best advice is what my mom always told me as a kid: where there's a will,
there's a way. If you want to get to the point where you're doing things on your own, you have to
keep doing things... Stay positive. Stay determined. [Read His Story ›][67]

Ottobock is a global medical technology company based in Germany, specializing in prosthetics,
orthotics, and mobility solutions. Founded in 1919, it focuses on improving quality of life through
innovation, advanced biomechanics, and personalized patient care worldwide.

1. Evaluation and Plan

The first part of the [POSI Process][131] consists of important questions about your hobbies and
daily activities etc. On top of that, we will give you a physical evaluation to test general muscle
strength and flexibility.

2. Hand Casting

This is the first step in fitting and will involve an impression of the residual limb. The hand cast
will be made using a plaster to create a model to be modified to fit each specific patient.

3. Diagnostic Fittings

During the diagnostic fitting, it allows us to continue to adjust to any changes that might need to
be made throughout the alignment process as well as make it more comfortable overall.

4. In-House Fabrication

In-House Fabrication simply makes it easier to make adjustments on site while you wait as well as
quick feedback.

Once everything is completed the delivery of prosthesis will happen and we will continue to monitor
your progress and follow-up.

# Welcome to Hanger Clinic

Expert Orthotic and Prosthetic Care in Chicago

[ Request an appointment ][52]

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. We create customized solutions for people of all ages,
including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, cranial helmets, and other devices designed to
increase the mobility and function of each person we serve.

[Request an Appointment][53]

Whether you’re visiting a former Scheck & Siress location or another Hanger Clinic location, we
provide dedicated, high-quality care focused on you, our patients. Scheck & Siress provided the
highest level of orthotic and prosthetic care for years before joining Hanger Clinic, and continues
to do so as part of the Hanger Clinic family, with the added benefits of additional resources.

## Find a Clinic Near You

Choose a convenient Chicago area location from the list below, or [search all of our clinics][54].

## Explore Our Expertise

### *****The peace of mind you need. The commitment you deserve.*****

We create customized solutions—including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, supports, cranial
helmets, and other devices—designed to help you live your best life. Our commitment is to listen to
you, get to know you as a person, and do everything we can to help you achieve your potential.

[male patient with above-knee prosthesis sitting on steps]

## Lower Limb Prosthetics

With solutions for all levels of lower limb loss and limb difference, including above-knee
amputation and below-knee amputation, our expert prosthetists will work with you to find the best
prosthetic solution for you.

***Technology Highlights:***
* [Microprocessor Knees][55]
* [Microprocessor Feet][56]
* [Hydraulic Ankle/Feet][57]

[male clinician with male patient with right arm prosthesis]

## Upper Limb Prosthetics

Our upper limb specialists design custom prosthetic solutions for people needing prosthetic arms,
hands, and fingers. Our advanced materials and state-of-the-art components work with you and empower
you to continue to do the things you love.

***Technology Highlight:***
* [*Myoelectric Hooks and Hands*][58]

## Cranial Helmets

Cranial remolding helmets are often prescribed to treat cranial asymmetry, like plagiocephaly, also
known as “flat head syndrome.” We are here to help put your mind at ease by providing you with the
expertise, education, and support you need to feel comfortable and confident about the journey
ahead.

[Learn More >][59]

## Lower Limb Bracing

Our clinicians work with individuals of all ages and offer a full range of treatment options ranging
from sports orthoses for young athletes to specialty orthoses to help treat a variety of
neuromuscular and orthopedic disorders including cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, and down
syndrome.

[Learn More >][60]

## Scoliosis Bracing

A spine doctor may prescribe a scoliosis brace, also known as a Thoracic Lumbar Sacral Orthosis
(TLSO) for your child. The TLSO works by applying pressure over the back in specific areas to
straighten the spine while your child is wearing the brace.

[Learn More >][61]

* ## Become Adaptive
  
  Helping you reach the highest level of functionality possible. We specialize in providing
  artificial limbs and custom orthopedic bracing to our patients. We truly care about our patients
  and strive to provide them the care they deserve.
  
  [Learn More][23]

## Our Goal

We want to get you back to your daily activities as quickly and safely as possible. We will put you
in the best components to suit your needs. We will spend the time to understand your needs and make
sure your device is functional, comfortable, and satisfactory to you.

## Who We Are

Adaptive Prosthetics and Orthotics, llc. is a local, independent provider who takes pride in giving
you the individualized attention and care you deserve. We started in 1997 with our first location in
Glastonbury, CT and now have additional locations in:

** Glastonbury, CT**
**Norwich, CT**
**Waterford, CT,  **
**Providence, RI, **
**[Agawam, MA][24].**

[Read More >][25]

## Prosthetics

The staff at Adaptive Prosthetics & Orthotics, llc. is dedicated to meeting all your prosthetic
needs. We take pride in giving you the individual attention you deserve. We provide on-time
appointments and on-site fabrication. Call today for a free consultation.

[Read More >][26]

## Orthotic Bracing

When you come to Adaptive Prosthetics & Orthotics, llc., you’re coming to a company that is
dedicated to giving you the personalized experience you deserve. We accept most major insurance
plans and promise you a quick turnaround time so you can get back to your life.

[Read More >][27]

## Mastectomy

When you come to Adaptive Prosthetics & Orthotics, LLC, you’re coming to a company that is dedicated
to giving you the personalized care you deserve after breast surgery. We provide a comfortable,
private fitting experience so you can feel confident and supported every step of the way.

[Read More >][28]

## Compression

Gradient compression hosiery promotes better blood flow and helps prevent pooling of fluid in the
body. Finding the right compression garment for you is a detailed process. We work with you and your
doctor to find the best garment for your condition whether it be varicose veins, lymphatic edema, or
chronic venous insufficiency.

The design of a prosthesis is based on considerations like your overall health, activity level,
strength and flexibility, employment requirements, hobbies, and interests. The prosthesis consists
of a custom socket to fit your residual limb and component parts like knees and feet, which are
selected to fit your specific needs. All parts of the prosthesis require regular maintenance and
occasional…

#### [Orthotics][42]

[Services][43]
Orthotic devices can be used to solve a variety of neurological and musculoskeletal conditions.
Acute injury, chronic pain, diabetic complications, bone fractures, and scoliosis are just some of
the more common ailments that Adaptive’s team of certified Orthotists can help remedy. Whether you
are fitted and receive a brace directly off our shelves from the leaders in orthotic bracing
devices…
[Learn more][44]
[Diabetic Shoes]

#### [Diabetic Shoes][45]

[Services][46]
Why are Diabetic Shoes important? Poorly controlled blood sugar can damage many parts of the body,
including the nerves and vessels that go to the feet. Because of this, people with diabetes have an
increased risk of developing foot problems. Wearing specialty-designed shoes can help reduce risk
and promote healthy circulation in your feet. Some advantages of wearing Diabetic Shoes…

[Services][46]

including the nerves and vessels that go to the feet. Because of this, people with diabetes have an
increased risk of developing foot problems. Wearing specialty-designed shoes can help reduce risk
and promote healthy circulation in your feet. Some advantages of wearing Diabetic Shoes…

connectivity.

# Bekey - custom software development company

BeKey is a custom software application development company, based in the USA and founded in 2016,
which aims to develop trusted products that benefit people. The company is headquartered in Israel
and has a development center in Ukraine.

## Сustom software for business

BeKey provides clients around the world with development teams and creates custom software for
startups. Start collaborating with top experts in software and mobile apps development, data
analysis, design, quality assurance, and marketing, and let them introduce the most cost-effective
technologies for your team!

## Our Mission

BeKey’s biggest goal is to influence the world of tech startups so much by supporting startups at
all stages of creating their own product so that each of them can finally grow their own unicorn. We
work with those who want to create products to help solve urgent problems and bring value to people.
We like to see the results of our work, which have a positive effect on industries and people’s
lives.

## We Provide Agile Software Development Services

Agile software development is one of the most effective methods of moving from idea to product.
Agile development uses stable planning and focuses on collaboration and gradual progress. It allows
you to respond quickly to changes, rather than being tied to a plan. Our pool of certified and
experienced developers helps us accelerate software development without compromising on quality. Due
to this, we have successfully implemented a number of projects.

## Want To Develop A Custom Software Solution?

We know from our own experience how to create custom software development projects. As part of an
efficient development cycle, we can meet all your needs: from improving internal processes to
updating customer services with bespoke intuitive software. Outsourcing a flexible and manageable
team means that you get a quality product built according to your specifications.

## We Provide Our IT Services to Various Industries

Our IT areas of expertise:
* Digital healthcare (we have enough experience to be named a [healthcare software development][17]
  agency);
* Advertising and marketing;
* Wellness & fitness app development;
* Hospitality & tourism;
* Internet of Things;
* Business process automation.

## Our Software Development Cycle

The software development cycle is a conceptual structure that integrates all project activities,

## Compassionate Care from Certified Experts

Founded in 2007, Bionic Prosthetics & Orthotics combines board-certified clinicians with
personalized care plans helping thousands regain comfort, mobility, and confidence.
* Certified & state-licensed prosthetists & orthotists
* Custom solutions for children & adults
* Full-service fittings, adjustments & follow-up care
* Functional Electrical Stimulation (FES) options

[Meet Our Team][40]
[Compassionate Care from Certified Experts.webp]

## Services We Offer

Every person’s movement is unique, and prosthetic or orthotic solutions should reflect your body,
condition, and daily life. At Bionic Prosthetics & Orthotics, we begin with a detailed clinical
evaluation to recommend solutions focused on function, comfort, and long-term use.

[Prosthetic Care.webp]

### Prosthetic Care

Our prosthetic services support individuals with upper- and lower-limb loss or limb difference at
every stage of life.

We focus on:
* Restoring balance and natural movement patterns
* Reducing energy loss and fatigue during walking or daily activities
* Supporting work, recreation, and independent living

Each prosthesis is carefully selected and customized based on your anatomy, mobility goals, and
lifestyle, with ongoing adjustments as your needs evolve.

### Orthotic Care

Orthotic care is designed to support the body’s structure, improve alignment, and reduce strain on
muscles and joints.

We provide custom orthotic solutions for:
* Foot and ankle instability
* Knee, hip, and spinal conditions
* Post-injury and post-surgical recovery
* Long-term musculoskeletal conditions

Our goal is to improve comfort, stability, and movement efficiency while helping reduce pain and
prevent further complications.

[Orthotic Care.webp]
[Diabetic Foot Care.webp]

### Diabetic Foot Care

Diabetes can significantly affect foot health, circulation, and sensation, making proper support
essential.

Our diabetic foot care services focus on:
* Reducing pressure on high-risk areas
* Protecting sensitive or vulnerable tissue
* Supporting safe, confident walking

We design specialized footwear and orthotic solutions to help lower the risk of ulcers and other
complications while supporting long-term mobility.

### Pediatric Prosthetics & Orthotics

Children’s prosthetic and orthotic needs change as they grow, develop, and become more active.

Our pediatric care emphasizes:
* Comfort and proper fit during growth
* Supporting healthy movement and development
* Encouraging confidence at home, school, and play

We work closely with families and care teams to ensure each solution adapts over time, supporting
both physical development and independence.

# The COVVI Hand

## Redefining Ability, Transforming Lives

Strong, robust, and feature-rich; the team behind COVVI has developed a highly functional bionic
hand that establishes a new level of quality and performance through its cutting-edge design

[ Learn More ** ][37]
[**][38]

# COVVI Touch

**Touch sensing technology** at your fingertips.

By sending **vibrational feedback** directly to the prosthetic user’s residual limb when the COVVI
Hand grasps an object, COVVI Touch relays a true sense of touch from **every fingertip of the
hand**. 

[ Find Out More ** ][39]
[COVVI Homepage]

## COVVI Go App

Personalise your COVVI Hand with unique configurations.

[ Learn More ** ][40]
[COVVI Homepage]

## COVVI Wrist Suite

Explore two new shorter, lighter versions of the COVVI Hand.

[ Learn More ** ][41]
[COVVI Homepage]

## **How can I get a COVVI Hand?**

### Clinicians and Prosthetists

Want to receive training from COVVI clinicians, or order a bionic hand? We can assist you in
providing the best care for your patients.

[ Learn More ** ][42]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

### Patients and Users

**Looking to start your COVVI journey?** Our dedicated team is ready to support you in getting
started.

[ Get In Touch ** ][43]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

### Distributors and Providers

**Interested in distributing COVVI products?** As COVVI aims to support people around the world, we
are always looking to expand our network.

[ Work With Us ** ][44]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

# Unmatched Personalisation

**Made for people with congenital and acquired limb differences, both above and below the elbow.**
Our premium bionic hand comes in **three sizes, **a variety of **striking colour options **and will
soon be available in** three wrist types**. With full personalisation over the hand’s functions
through the **COVVI Go App**.

[ Our Product Range ** ][45]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

# Advanced Technology

**Strong **(liftsup to **30kg**), **powerful **(up to **90N grip force**), and **precise **(**24+
grips**). Unique technology, including smart fingertips, novel grip switches, patented powered thumb
rotation, touchscreen capability, remote support assistance, built-in flex wrist, and so much more.

Why EuroClinics

## Healthcare-grade trust, built into every step

The four pillars below are non-negotiable. Every profile, every booking, every record.

### Verified credentials

Every doctor and clinic is crossmatched against national medical registries before any profile goes
live.

### GDPR-by-design

Data residency in the EU, no advertising trackers on profile pages, and your search history is never
sold.

### Transparent pricing

Quoted treatments include the full breakdown — consultation, procedure, anesthesia, follow-up — no
hidden fees.

### Continuity of care

Secure messaging with your provider lasts beyond the appointment, with records portable in standard
FHIR format.

together with trusted care, helpful tools, and support for people living with Guillain-Barré

Neuropathy (MMN).

HSI specializes in biomedical engineering, offering expert training and personalized consultations
in medical device design and health software development. Our specialized courses empower
professionals and organizations to drive innovation and make a meaningful impact in healthcare.

[ About Us ][10] [ Register ][11]
Who are we?

### Empowers professionals with cutting-edge expertise in biomedical engineering.

Revolutionizing healthcare through innovation

### We Pioneer biomedical engineering

HSI Center specializes in biomedical engineering, offering a comprehensive range of expert-led
courses and innovative healthcare solutions. Our programs focus on equipping professionals with
essential skills in medical device design, health software development, and healthcare system
management. In addition to specialized training, we provide personalized guidance to support career
growth and expert consulting services for healthcare organizations seeking innovative advancements.
By integrating education and consulting, HSI Center empowers individuals and institutions to drive
progress and make a lasting impact in the healthcare industry.

Welcome to our comprehensive resource dedicated to the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), a
pivotal civil rights law enacted to prohibit discrimination against individuals with disabilities in
all areas of public life. Our mission is to inform, guide, and inspire by providing a thorough
understanding of the ADA’s history, principles, and the ongoing efforts towards greater
accessibility and inclusion. Whether you’re an individual seeking to understand your rights, an
employer aiming to create an inclusive workplace, or simply an advocate for equality, our platform
offers an extensive array of resources, including detailed articles, latest updates, legal cases,
and innovative practices from around the world.

# Get The Best Prosthetic and Orthotic Care in Texas at LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and
# Prosthetics

Amputees and those needing orthotic bracing today have unlimited choices of products and care.
Nowhere is this more noticeable than at LeTourneau Lifelike [Orthotics][27] and [Prosthetics][28],
Inc. Our family-owned company has provided advanced prosthetic and orthotic care for over three
decades to adult and pediatric patients. We have received the highest awards for care and service,
in a friendly, caring setting for both you and your family.

LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics has pioneered many advanced O&P innovations by
developing unique products such as Perfect Skin™, the [Neutralizer Knee Brace][29]™, the Stealth
Brace™ and the Acti-Ankle™. Our trained, experienced and knowledgeable team will be happy to assist
you or a loved one.

# About LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics

Get the very best prosthetic technology and advanced orthotics in Texas at LeTourneau & Family
Orthotics and Prosthetics. World renowned experts with superior service. LeTourneau & Family
Orthotics and Prosthetics was founded in Beaumont, Texas and expanded to Jasper and Nederland, TX.
Word spread rapidly of the quality care, and superior customer service that Tom LeTourneau and his
staff were providing patients. Requests poured in from surrounding communities for that same quality
care and customer service. [(Read more)][30]

# The Most Advanced Technology

LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics is a leader in orthoses and prostheses design and
management in Texas. They designed both the Te-Evolution and Perfect Skin. They also developed the
Ultra-G Fabrication technique used in orthotic design. The highly trained and certified
professionals at LeTourneau continually utilize [(Read More) ][31]

# i-Limb Hand

The [i-LIMB Hand][32]. The world’s first fully articulating and commercially available bionic
hand. LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics is a leader in advanced upper-limb prosthetics
(ULP). While LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics has provided myoelectric prosthetics for
years, three new products now are commercially available. The i-LIMB hand, from Touch Bionics, is a
first-to-market prosthetic device with five individually powered digits. This artificial limb looks
and acts like a real human hand and represents a generational advance in bionics and patient
care. [(Read more)][33]

# LeTourneau Kids

“Those are our kids, too,” says Tom LeTourneau, whose company has helped countless infants,
children, adolescents as well as teens overcome physical disabilities over the years. “We basically
adopt all the kids who need our services. Our motto for all pediatric cases is, ‘Let’s face it … 
TOGETHER.’ We want to be there for the long haul and help our kids reach their full potential.”

Through advanced technology, an intra-team discipline and more than 125 years of combined
experience, LeTourneau KIDS offers the best pediatric prosthetic and orthotic program available
anywhere in the world. ([Read More][34])

## The Socket-less Socket™ Transforms Quality Of Life

Our clinical research team collects data across our entire patient panel to measure the quality of
life impacts of our Socket-less Socket™ technology, and the results are transformative.

[ Check Out The Socket-less Socket™ Clinical Outcomes Here ][52]
The Socket-less Socket™ Is 3.3X More Comfortable Than Conventional Rigid Sockets
77% Decrease In Skin Issues And Breakdown
94% Increase In Sitting Comfort, Thanks To Unrestricted Range Of Motion.
42% Increase In Daily Wear Time

# Now Available Coast-to-Coast

Our latest socket technology is available coast-to-coast through our own Martin Bionics Clinics as
well as through our quickly expanding Clinical Network of practitioners who are trained and
experienced in fitting our life-changing socket technology.

We aim for every patient fit with the Socket-less Socket™ to experience a transformed quality of
life through newfound comfort and mobility. Our staff will do everything within their power to have
our patients say, ****“This is the most comfortable socket I’ve ever worn.”****

Many of our patients travel from across the country and around the world for our life-changing
comfort.

骼设备,为运动功能障碍人群提供高性价比的训练及助力产品。

## THE PREMIER FORUM FOR PROSTHETICS AND ROBOTICS

Welcome to Prosthetics & Robotics 2026, the premier gathering of innovators, researchers,
clinicians, and industry leaders shaping the future of human-machine integration.

With traditional prosthetics still limited in adaptability, sensory feedback, and user comfort, this
event highlights the next generation of solutions powered by robotics, AI, soft materials, and
advanced sensing. From intelligent limb systems to responsive exoskeletons, attendees will explore
cutting-edge technologies that are transforming rehabilitation, restoring function, and improving
quality of life.

Join us to explore the latest technologies, connect with leading professionals, and deepen your
expertise in rehabilitation.

## Key topics for 2026

#### Emerging Innovations in Prosthetics and Robotics

Explore advancements redefining human-technology integration, from AI-powered limbs to robotic
platforms designed for personalized mobility and assistive care.

#### Neural Interfaces and Biointegration for Prosthetic Control

Discover breakthroughs in biohybrid systems such as BCIs, implantable sensors, and tissue interfaces
that enable seamless prosthetic control and feedback.

#### Case studies on Residual Limb Imaging and Digital Twin Applications

Use cutting-edge tools like digital twins, AI, and high-resolution imaging to improve socket
alignment, gait performance, and long-term prosthetic adaptation.

#### AI-Driven Exoskeletons and Rehabilitation Technologies

Examine intelligent exoskeletons that integrate real-time biomechanics, neuromuscular stimulation,
and XR technologies to accelerate recovery and restore autonomy.

#### Advancing Personalized Prosthetics and 3D Printing innovations

The integration of AI modeling, bioresorbable materials, and precision 3D printing continues to
transform the design and delivery of next-generation prosthetic solutions.

#### Global Regulations, Ethical Standards, and Safety Frameworks

Gain insight into evolving regulations, ethical standards, and risk strategies influencing
innovation and deployment across global markets.

cancellation, if above criteria is met. We will use the same means of payment as You used for the
Service Booking, and You will not incur any fees for such reimbursement.

Our Story

## From prosthetics to the
## future of wearables.

In 2012, a teenager named Easton LaChappelle walked into a Colorado science fair carrying a robotic
arm he'd built in his bedroom. There, he met a young girl wearing an $80,000 prosthetic that could
barely open and close. That encounter set the trajectory for everything that followed.

Founded in 2014 with backing from Tony Robbins, Unlimited Tomorrow spent a decade developing the
core technologies behind human-machine interfaces — 3D scanning, additive manufacturing, embedded
sensor systems, haptic feedback, and machine learning. What began as a mission to reinvent
prosthetics evolved into a broader platform for wearable technology that connects the human body to
the digital world.

Our IP portfolio spans patents covering adaptive grip control, sensor-driven interfaces, and
proprietary manufacturing processes — the foundation that now powers both our prosthetic and haptic
platforms.

#### Mechanical & Electromechanical Design

Complex assemblies, miniaturized actuators, sensor integration, and human-body-interface systems

02

#### Additive Manufacturing

In-house multi-material 3D printing with production-grade PA12 nylon, color matching, and one-of-one
manufacturing at scale.

03

#### Embedded Systems & Firmware

Real-time sensor processing, haptic feedback loops, motor control, and cloud-connected device
architectures for wearable hardware.

04

#### Human Factors & Clinical Fit

Remote fitting workflows, ergonomic optimization, and user research informed by years of working
directly with end users in medical contexts.

05

#### Rapid Prototyping to Production

From concept validation through FDA-relevant documentation, quality management, and production line
build-out — all under one roof.

06

#### Software & Machine Learning

Signal processing, adaptive control algorithms, user-facing applications, and ML pipelines trained
on proprietary biomechanical datasets.

We take on a limited number of development partnerships each year with companies whose work aligns
with our mission.

Our Story

## From prosthetics to the
## future of wearables.

In 2012, a teenager named Easton LaChappelle walked into a Colorado science fair carrying a robotic
arm he'd built in his bedroom. There, he met a young girl wearing an $80,000 prosthetic that could
barely open and close. That encounter set the trajectory for everything that followed.

Founded in 2014 with backing from Tony Robbins, Unlimited Tomorrow spent a decade developing the
core technologies behind human-machine interfaces — 3D scanning, additive manufacturing, embedded
sensor systems, haptic feedback, and machine learning. What began as a mission to reinvent
prosthetics evolved into a broader platform for wearable technology that connects the human body to
the digital world.

Our IP portfolio spans patents covering adaptive grip control, sensor-driven interfaces, and
proprietary manufacturing processes — the foundation that now powers both our prosthetic and haptic
platforms.

manufacturing at scale.

03

#### Embedded Systems & Firmware

architectures for wearable hardware.

04

#### Human Factors & Clinical Fit

Remote fitting workflows, ergonomic optimization, and user research informed by years of working
directly with end users in medical contexts.

05

#### Rapid Prototyping to Production

From concept validation through FDA-relevant documentation, quality management, and production line
build-out — all under one roof.

06

#### Software & Machine Learning

Signal processing, adaptive control algorithms, user-facing applications, and ML pipelines trained
on proprietary biomechanical datasets.

Инновационные решения для улучшения качества жизни людей с ограниченными возможностями

## О нашей работе

Наша миссия — помогать людям с ограниченными возможностями здоровья вести полноценную жизнь. Мы
находим и изучаем современные протезы, учитывая индивидуальные потребности человека.
[

порядок обжалования отказа. Компенсация стоимости при самостоятельной покупке. Чем отличается

косметические), как проходит подбор и подгонка, что включает уход за культёй и протезом, как
справиться с фантомными болями и адаптироваться психологически.
][87]
[
Сколько стоит протез в 2025 году?
Узнайте, сколько стоит протез ноги, руки и бионический протез в 2025 году. Цены, сравнение моделей,
компенсация, квоты и налоговые льготы.
][88]

(ИПР), бионические протезы, правовые аспекты в РФ. Для пациентов и специалистов.

пассивные), какие технологии управления используют, как происходит сенсорная обратная связь и
миоэлектрическое управление

(i-Limb, LUKE Arm), принципов работы, стоимости и реабилитации. Как выбрать современный протез?

## ACCEPT NO LIMITATIONS

With 10 patient care facilities throughout Ohio and an 18,000 square foot fabrication and clinical
facility, we use the most advanced technologies available, creating customized bionic devices that
enable patients to live life to the fullest. Our fabrication facility features CAD/CAM manufacturing
processes and cutting-edge equipment used by certified technicians delivering the highest quality
orthotic and prosthetic devices throughout Ohio. Our facility also has a conference/ media room for
ongoing technical education for our staff and the medical community.

Every life is different and each of us must face a different set of challenges. Our primary goal is
to help patients enjoy their favorite activities — from walking, running, dancing, playing golf or
climbing mountains — even after the loss of a limb.

### Common Questions About Cochlear Hearing Implants

### How is a hearing implant different from a hearing aid?

A cochlear implant (CI), sometimes referred to as a hearing implant, is considered the next step in
hearing technology when hearing aids are no longer providing the sound or support someone needs.
Hearing aids go on the outside of the body and work like a speaker, making sound louder. Cochlear
implants go under the skin and send sound waves directly to your hearing nerve for clearer
understanding. 

[ Learn more about the process for adults ][84]

### Are cochlear implants safe?

Yes. Cochlear implants are extremely safe. They’ve been used for decades and have helped hundreds of
thousands of people around the world hear again and reconnect with life.

  and strive to provide them the care they deserve.
  
  [Learn More][23]

## Our Goal

We want to get you back to your daily activities as quickly and safely as possible. We will put you
in the best components to suit your needs. We will spend the time to understand your needs and make
sure your device is functional, comfortable, and satisfactory to you.

## Who We Are

Adaptive Prosthetics and Orthotics, llc. is a local, independent provider who takes pride in giving
you the individualized attention and care you deserve. We started in 1997 with our first location in
Glastonbury, CT and now have additional locations in:

## Prosthetics

The staff at Adaptive Prosthetics & Orthotics, llc. is dedicated to meeting all your prosthetic
needs. We take pride in giving you the individual attention you deserve. We provide on-time
appointments and on-site fabrication. Call today for a free consultation.

[Read More >][26]

## Orthotic Bracing

When you come to Adaptive Prosthetics & Orthotics, llc., you’re coming to a company that is
dedicated to giving you the personalized experience you deserve. We accept most major insurance
plans and promise you a quick turnaround time so you can get back to your life.

[Read More >][27]

## Mastectomy

When you come to Adaptive Prosthetics & Orthotics, LLC, you’re coming to a company that is dedicated
to giving you the personalized care you deserve after breast surgery. We provide a comfortable,
private fitting experience so you can feel confident and supported every step of the way.

[Read More >][28]

## Compression

Gradient compression hosiery promotes better blood flow and helps prevent pooling of fluid in the
body. Finding the right compression garment for you is a detailed process. We work with you and your
doctor to find the best garment for your condition whether it be varicose veins, lymphatic edema, or
chronic venous insufficiency.

[Services][46]

including the nerves and vessels that go to the feet. Because of this, people with diabetes have an
increased risk of developing foot problems. Wearing specialty-designed shoes can help reduce risk
and promote healthy circulation in your feet. Some advantages of wearing Diabetic Shoes…

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# The COVVI Hand

## Redefining Ability, Transforming Lives

Strong, robust, and feature-rich; the team behind COVVI has developed a highly functional bionic
hand that establishes a new level of quality and performance through its cutting-edge design

[ Learn More ** ][37]
[**][38]

# COVVI Touch

**Touch sensing technology** at your fingertips.

By sending **vibrational feedback** directly to the prosthetic user’s residual limb when the COVVI
Hand grasps an object, COVVI Touch relays a true sense of touch from **every fingertip of the
hand**. 

[ Find Out More ** ][39]
[COVVI Homepage]

## COVVI Go App

Personalise your COVVI Hand with unique configurations.

[ Learn More ** ][40]
[COVVI Homepage]

## COVVI Wrist Suite

Explore two new shorter, lighter versions of the COVVI Hand.

[ Learn More ** ][41]
[COVVI Homepage]

## **How can I get a COVVI Hand?**

### Clinicians and Prosthetists

Want to receive training from COVVI clinicians, or order a bionic hand? We can assist you in
providing the best care for your patients.

[ Learn More ** ][42]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

### Patients and Users

**Looking to start your COVVI journey?** Our dedicated team is ready to support you in getting
started.

[ Get In Touch ** ][43]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

### Distributors and Providers

**Interested in distributing COVVI products?** As COVVI aims to support people around the world, we
are always looking to expand our network.

[ Work With Us ** ][44]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

# Unmatched Personalisation

**Made for people with congenital and acquired limb differences, both above and below the elbow.**
Our premium bionic hand comes in **three sizes, **a variety of **striking colour options **and will
soon be available in** three wrist types**. With full personalisation over the hand’s functions
through the **COVVI Go App**.

[ Our Product Range ** ][45]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]
[COVVI Homepage][COVVI Homepage]

# Advanced Technology

**Strong **(liftsup to **30kg**), **powerful **(up to **90N grip force**), and **precise **(**24+
grips**). Unique technology, including smart fingertips, novel grip switches, patented powered thumb
rotation, touchscreen capability, remote support assistance, built-in flex wrist, and so much more.

together with trusted care, helpful tools, and support for people living with Guillain-Barré
Syndrome (GBS), Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP), and Multifocal Motor
Neuropathy (MMN).

# HSI for Biomedical engineering training

HSI specializes in biomedical engineering, offering expert training and personalized consultations
in medical device design and health software development. Our specialized courses empower
professionals and organizations to drive innovation and make a meaningful impact in healthcare.

[ About Us ][10] [ Register ][11]
Who are we?

### Empowers professionals with cutting-edge expertise in biomedical engineering.

Revolutionizing healthcare through innovation

### We Pioneer biomedical engineering

HSI Center specializes in biomedical engineering, offering a comprehensive range of expert-led
courses and innovative healthcare solutions. Our programs focus on equipping professionals with
essential skills in medical device design, health software development, and healthcare system
management. In addition to specialized training, we provide personalized guidance to support career
growth and expert consulting services for healthcare organizations seeking innovative advancements.
By integrating education and consulting, HSI Center empowers individuals and institutions to drive
progress and make a lasting impact in the healthcare industry.

# Get The Best Prosthetic and Orthotic Care in Texas at LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and
# Prosthetics

Amputees and those needing orthotic bracing today have unlimited choices of products and care.
Nowhere is this more noticeable than at LeTourneau Lifelike [Orthotics][27] and [Prosthetics][28],
Inc. Our family-owned company has provided advanced prosthetic and orthotic care for over three
decades to adult and pediatric patients. We have received the highest awards for care and service,
in a friendly, caring setting for both you and your family.

LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics has pioneered many advanced O&P innovations by
developing unique products such as Perfect Skin™, the [Neutralizer Knee Brace][29]™, the Stealth
Brace™ and the Acti-Ankle™. Our trained, experienced and knowledgeable team will be happy to assist
you or a loved one.

# About LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics

Get the very best prosthetic technology and advanced orthotics in Texas at LeTourneau & Family
Orthotics and Prosthetics. World renowned experts with superior service. LeTourneau & Family
Orthotics and Prosthetics was founded in Beaumont, Texas and expanded to Jasper and Nederland, TX.
Word spread rapidly of the quality care, and superior customer service that Tom LeTourneau and his
staff were providing patients. Requests poured in from surrounding communities for that same quality
care and customer service. [(Read more)][30]

# The Most Advanced Technology

LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics is a leader in orthoses and prostheses design and
management in Texas. They designed both the Te-Evolution and Perfect Skin. They also developed the
Ultra-G Fabrication technique used in orthotic design. The highly trained and certified
professionals at LeTourneau continually utilize [(Read More) ][31]

# i-Limb Hand

The [i-LIMB Hand][32]. The world’s first fully articulating and commercially available bionic
hand. LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics is a leader in advanced upper-limb prosthetics
(ULP). While LeTourneau & Family Orthotics and Prosthetics has provided myoelectric prosthetics for
years, three new products now are commercially available. The i-LIMB hand, from Touch Bionics, is a
first-to-market prosthetic device with five individually powered digits. This artificial limb looks
and acts like a real human hand and represents a generational advance in bionics and patient
care. [(Read more)][33]

# LeTourneau Kids

“Those are our kids, too,” says Tom LeTourneau, whose company has helped countless infants,
children, adolescents as well as teens overcome physical disabilities over the years. “We basically
adopt all the kids who need our services. Our motto for all pediatric cases is, ‘Let’s face it … 
TOGETHER.’ We want to be there for the long haul and help our kids reach their full potential.”

Through advanced technology, an intra-team discipline and more than 125 years of combined
experience, LeTourneau KIDS offers the best pediatric prosthetic and orthotic program available
anywhere in the world. ([Read More][34])

solutions.

segments:

## THE PREMIER FORUM FOR PROSTHETICS AND ROBOTICS

Welcome to Prosthetics & Robotics 2026, the premier gathering of innovators, researchers,
clinicians, and industry leaders shaping the future of human-machine integration.

With traditional prosthetics still limited in adaptability, sensory feedback, and user comfort, this
event highlights the next generation of solutions powered by robotics, AI, soft materials, and
advanced sensing. From intelligent limb systems to responsive exoskeletons, attendees will explore
cutting-edge technologies that are transforming rehabilitation, restoring function, and improving
quality of life.

Join us to explore the latest technologies, connect with leading professionals, and deepen your
expertise in rehabilitation.

## Key topics for 2026

#### Emerging Innovations in Prosthetics and Robotics

Explore advancements redefining human-technology integration, from AI-powered limbs to robotic
platforms designed for personalized mobility and assistive care.

#### Neural Interfaces and Biointegration for Prosthetic Control

Discover breakthroughs in biohybrid systems such as BCIs, implantable sensors, and tissue interfaces
that enable seamless prosthetic control and feedback.

#### Case studies on Residual Limb Imaging and Digital Twin Applications

Use cutting-edge tools like digital twins, AI, and high-resolution imaging to improve socket
alignment, gait performance, and long-term prosthetic adaptation.

#### AI-Driven Exoskeletons and Rehabilitation Technologies

Examine intelligent exoskeletons that integrate real-time biomechanics, neuromuscular stimulation,
and XR technologies to accelerate recovery and restore autonomy.

#### Advancing Personalized Prosthetics and 3D Printing innovations

The integration of AI modeling, bioresorbable materials, and precision 3D printing continues to
transform the design and delivery of next-generation prosthetic solutions.

#### Global Regulations, Ethical Standards, and Safety Frameworks

Gain insight into evolving regulations, ethical standards, and risk strategies influencing
innovation and deployment across global markets.

clear statement. You can inform us of your decision by:
* By email: contact@robobionics.in

We will reimburse You no later than 7 days from the day on which We receive your request for
cancellation, if above criteria is met. We will use the same means of payment as You used for the
Service Booking, and You will not incur any fees for such reimbursement.

Please note in case you miss a Service Booking or Re-schedule the same we shall only entertain the
request once.

## Conditions For Returns

In order for the Goods to be eligible for a return, please make sure that:
* The Goods were purchased in the last 14 days

* The supply of Goods made to Your specifications or clearly personalized.

* The supply of Goods which are not suitable for return due to health protection or hygiene reasons

* The supply of Goods which are, after delivery, according to their nature, inseparably mixed with
  other items.

We reserve the right to refuse returns of any merchandise that does not meet the above return
conditions in our sole discretion.

Only regular priced Goods may be refunded by 50%. Unfortunately, Goods on sale cannot be refunded.
This exclusion may not apply to You if it is not permitted by applicable law.

Our Story

## From prosthetics to the
## future of wearables.

In 2012, a teenager named Easton LaChappelle walked into a Colorado science fair carrying a robotic
arm he'd built in his bedroom. There, he met a young girl wearing an $80,000 prosthetic that could
barely open and close. That encounter set the trajectory for everything that followed.

Founded in 2014 with backing from Tony Robbins, Unlimited Tomorrow spent a decade developing the
core technologies behind human-machine interfaces — 3D scanning, additive manufacturing, embedded
sensor systems, haptic feedback, and machine learning. What began as a mission to reinvent
prosthetics evolved into a broader platform for wearable technology that connects the human body to
the digital world.

Our IP portfolio spans patents covering adaptive grip control, sensor-driven interfaces, and
proprietary manufacturing processes — the foundation that now powers both our prosthetic and haptic
platforms.

## A decade of building
## at the edge.

The same engineering, manufacturing, and R&D infrastructure behind our wearable platforms is
available to select partners working on advanced hardware challenges.

01

#### Mechanical & Electromechanical Design

Complex assemblies, miniaturized actuators, sensor integration, and human-body-interface systems
refined through thousands of production units.

02

#### Additive Manufacturing

In-house multi-material 3D printing with production-grade PA12 nylon, color matching, and one-of-one
manufacturing at scale.

03

#### Embedded Systems & Firmware

Real-time sensor processing, haptic feedback loops, motor control, and cloud-connected device
architectures for wearable hardware.

04

#### Human Factors & Clinical Fit

Remote fitting workflows, ergonomic optimization, and user research informed by years of working
directly with end users in medical contexts.

05

#### Rapid Prototyping to Production

From concept validation through FDA-relevant documentation, quality management, and production line
build-out — all under one roof.

06

#### Software & Machine Learning

Signal processing, adaptive control algorithms, user-facing applications, and ML pipelines trained
on proprietary biomechanical datasets.

We take on a limited number of development partnerships each year with companies whose work aligns
with our mission.

facility, we use the most advanced technologies available, creating customized bionic devices that
enable patients to live life to the fullest. Our fabrication facility features CAD/CAM manufacturing

## ACCEPT NO LIMITATIONS

With 10 patient care facilities throughout Ohio and an 18,000 square foot fabrication and clinical
facility, we use the most advanced technologies available, creating customized bionic devices that
enable patients to live life to the fullest. Our fabrication facility features CAD/CAM manufacturing
processes and cutting-edge equipment used by certified technicians delivering the highest quality
orthotic and prosthetic devices throughout Ohio. Our facility also has a conference/ media room for
ongoing technical education for our staff and the medical community.

Every life is different and each of us must face a different set of challenges. Our primary goal is
to help patients enjoy their favorite activities — from walking, running, dancing, playing golf or
climbing mountains — even after the loss of a limb.
